description: nf-core/rnasplice context, aligned to the pinned 1.0.4 schema. Differential splicing between two named groups.

suppa.help: Run the SUPPA splicing workflow (schema default on).

contrasts.help: The contrasts CSV naming the groups to compare. The user states the comparison (see required_user_params) and configure_run writes contrasts.csv into the run folder; an absolute path is the user's own file and is passed through.

required_user_params.name: contrasts
required_user_params.definition: Which groups to compare, written TREATMENT vs CONTROL using the 'condition' values in the samplesheet (one comparison per line). Nessie writes the contrasts CSV from it. Which side is the treatment is your call: results are reported as treatment minus control. If you already have a contrasts CSV on Luria, give its full path instead.

pipeline.name: nf-core/rnasplice
pipeline.core_rule: Columns: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, strandedness, condition. 'condition' groups samples; a contrasts CSV names the comparison.

notes: The comparison is defined by the 'condition' column plus a contrasts file. The user states the comparison and Nessie writes the file (seqera/contrasts.py); the direction is never defaulted.

sources.label: nf-core/rnasplice nextflow_schema.json @ 1.0.4
sources.notes: param names, types, defaults; suppa default true.

sources.label: nf-core/rnasplice assets/schema_input.json @ 1.0.4
sources.notes: required columns: sample, fastq_1, strandedness, condition (fastq_2 optional).

runtime.basis: First guess from typical nf-core runtimes on one 16-CPU Luria node (Nessie's default submit); not yet measured on Luria. Refine from real runs.
runtime.setup_label: building the STAR and Salmon indexes from the local genome (every run repeats it)
